title: Integrate the approved 36 Route/Gate icons and six incident emblems
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md, docs/DESIGN_RECONCILIATION.md and the referenced frozen docs/design sources. Rules Spec v1 is canonical: Repair/Sabotage each end at six, one direct player-card vote, private Route/Gate inputs and authoritative deterministic outcomes. The five-point/Witness/demo scripts and completed T01-T10 APIs are historical; preserve their existing tests/API compatibility without using them as new game rules. Edit only owned paths and use existing dependencies unless manifest ownership explicitly permits reviewed additions. Keep engine production pure and do not read credentials, provision services, deploy, publish PRs or start agents. Use original synthetic fixtures and verified assets only. Run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check; report outcomes and contract changes. Ingest only the separately approved original art delivery: three Route icons, three Gate icons and one emblem for each of the six incidents. This task integrates assets after asset-bible and contact-sheet review; the coding worker must not generate images through a credentialed API. Validate the 1024px master, transparent PNG/WebP export, 128px UI variant, accessible label, provenance, digest and incident palette coherence. Register the exact engine semantic keys and verify that every key resolves. Letter/number-only controls and copied placeholders cannot replace the approved art. Retain manifest references to the original approval evidence.
acceptance: Exactly 36 unique operational icons and six incident emblems map to the six canonical incident families.
Each approved asset has provenance, an accessible label, a verified digest and the required master/UI variants.
Transparent exports and legibility at small sizes are checked against the reviewed contact sheet before integration.
UI registry tests resolve every key while engine data remains independent of image paths.
